coordinated_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth, taking a quick morning shower
Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
Changing into work clothes, packing bag and checking phone for shift schedule
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working as a health care professional: patient care, clinical rounds, medication administration and charting
Commuting home from the hospital at the end of the shift
Cooking and eating dinner, using the induction cooker and range hood, then loading the dishwasher
Relaxing after work with the fan on and lights dimmed, avoiding air conditioner use during the grid peak request
Showering and cooling down after the hot day, using the dehumidifier to reduce bathroom humidity
Washing and drying today's work clothes in the washing machine and clothes dryer
Watching TV and using the computer while the bedroom fan runs for cooling
Getting ready for bed and sleeping
